pages.text: Wheels set your automobile's $(bold)Size$() and $(bold)Grip$(). Bigger wheels clear rougher terrain; higher grip means better cornering and less sliding.

pages.title: Wheel Types
pages.text: Crafted in the Auto Mechanic Table, under the Wheels category:$(br)Standard, Street and Carriage wheels for everyday driving$(br)Off-Road and Tractor wheels for rough terrain$(br)Plated, Steel, Gilded and Bejeweled wheels for extra grip$(br)Convertible wheels for a bit of everything
